title: SEVN 1.0 sidewalk visual-navigation dataset
summary: One frame-aligned real-street panorama corpus with low- and high-resolution pixels, local camera poses, a connected navigation graph, evaluator annotations, and an upstream provenance receipt.

source.name: Sidewalk Environment for Visual Navigation
source.upstream_description: Low- and high-resolution panoramic images, coordinates, labels, and a connectivity graph for simulated sidewalk visual navigation.

alignment_contract.note: Annotations cover a subset of frames; they are evaluator truth, not runtime observations.

evidence_boundary.reason: The V1 24-address panel and the address/panorama-disjoint V2 same-source panel have both been opened. The package remains reusable for Development, regression, feature caching, and hard-case analysis, but is not fresh confirmation data.

components.logical_name: SEVN frame coordinates and camera poses
components.description: PyTables frame table linking every panorama frame to local ORB-SLAM2 coordinates, heading, timestamp, node type, and trajectory group.

facts.coordinate_authority: local metric ORB-SLAM2 coordinates; not global GPS

components.description: Connected undirected NetworkX graph whose nodes are the same 4,988 frame ids and whose edges define allowed sidewalk transitions.

components.logical_name: SEVN door, house-number, and street-sign annotations
components.description: Frame-indexed bounding boxes and address linkage used to score door binding and text visibility; this component must stay outside runtime observations.
Gzip-compressed HDF5 tensor containing one 84x224 RGB panorama for each frame id.
ZIP archive with one RGB PNG panorama per frame; this is the pixel source used by the V2 OCR and mask-topology evaluation.
Local snapshot of the Zenodo record with title, authors, DOI, version, license, file sizes, checksums, and download URLs.
